title: Kafka & CDC Operations Center
description: Central health of Kafka, Kafka Connect and every Debezium connector

panels.description: Healthy only when the broker is up with one active controller and no offline or under-min-ISR partitions, the Connect worker is up, no connector is DEGRADED or FAILED, and every Debezium engine is connected to its database. Platform-wide (ignores the Connector filter).
